about.title: Nagu saabsan Raadiye
about.intro: Raadiye waa madal bulshada Muqdisho ka caawisa inay dib u hesho alaabtii ka luntay, iyadoo isku xirta qofkii helay iyo qofkii lahaa.
about.whatTitle: Qaab fudud oo dadka isugu soo celiya alaabtooda.
about.whatP1: Shay muhiim ah oo kaa lumay wuxuu noqon karaa welwel. Shay qof kale leeyahay oo aad hesho na wuu adkaan karaa.
about.whatP2: Raadiye waa meel keliya oo aad ka soo gudbin karto shay aad heshay, aad ka soo sheegi karto shay kaa lumay, ama aad kaga raadin karto alaabta la soo gudbiyay.
about.findBody: Raadi alaabta la helay ama alaabta qof ka lumay.
about.returnBody: Ka caawi qof inuu helo waxa uu leeyahay.
about.communityBody: Isku xir qofkii helay iyo milkiilaha iyadoo la isticmaalayo wada hadal gudaha ah ama wicitaan.
about.trustBody: Taleefanka lama muujiyo ilaa qof uu doono inuu xiriiro. Xog sir ah lama weydiisto.
about.step1Body: Soo gudbi shay aad heshay, ama shay kaa lumay.
about.step3Body: Muuji lambarka, wac, oo xaqiiji in shaygu yahay kan saxda ah. Ha is dhaafin lacag.
about.missionBody: Inaan ka dhigno helitaanka alaabta mid fudud oo bulshada u furan, iyadoon la dhaafin xogta gaarka ah.
about.closeTitle: Shay kasta oo la celiyo waa muhiim.
about.closeBody: Ficil yar oo daacadnimo ah ayaa qof kale wax badan uga dhigi kara.

services.title: Afar tallaabo: luntay ilaa la celiyo
services.body: Raadiye wuxuu dadweynaha u daayaa xog fudud, calaamadaha qarsoodiga ahna wuu qariyaa, si milkiilaha dhabta ah loo aqoonsado ka hor intaan lambarka la wadaagin.

services.lostBrowseBody: Raadi alaabta la helay iyo tii lumay. Shayada la midka ah waxaa lagu soo jeediyaa magaca, qaybta, iyo degmada.
services.lostPostBody: Qor calaamadaha. Haddii qofkii soo gudbiyay aqbalo, waxaad arki kartaa lambarka, si ammaan ah u wada hadashaa, oo aad soo celisaa.
services.privacyBody: Ha ku darin lambarrada sirta, baasaboorka, ama xog dheeraad ah cinwaanka dadweynaha. Ha dirin lacag. Kulanka ha ka dhigin meel dadweyne ah.
services.ctaBody: Shay kasta oo la celiyo waa kala duwan. Ku biir Raadiye oo caawi deriskaaga.
